decisions.name: Flat Bench Leg Raises

decisions.name: Smith Machine Rear Deltoid Row
decisions.reason: Smith machine version of the rear delt row; library has only the barbell version.

instructions_en: Set the bar near knee height, hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is near parallel, and take a wide overhand grip.
Unhook the bar and row it to your lower chest, flaring your elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze your rear delts briefly, then lower the bar under control until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Rear Deltoid Row Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Single-arm, bench-supported rear delt row; wger-1227 is the two-arm bent-over version and One-Arm Dumbbell Row keeps the elbow tucked.

instructions_en: Place one knee and hand on a flat bench with a flat back, holding a dumbbell in the free hand with an overhand grip.
Row the dumbbell toward your upper chest with the elbow flared wide, away from your torso.
Pause when the upper arm is level with your back, then lower slowly; finish the set and switch sides.

decisions.name: Stationary Abdominal Draw In
decisions.reason: Abdominal draw-in (hollowing the belly without moving the spine); same as wger-1828.

decisions.name: Rear Deltoid Row Barbell
decisions.reason: Same as Barbell Rear Delt Row.

decisions.name: T-Bar Rows
decisions.reason: Standing bent-over T-bar row with a narrow handle; same as T-Bar Row with Handle.

decisions.name: Incline Shoulder Press Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Dumbbell press on an incline bench; same as Incline Dumbbell Press.

decisions.name: Bent Over Rear Deltoid Raise With Head On Bench
decisions.reason: Same exercise and name.

decisions.name: Seated Rear Lateral Cable Raise
decisions.reason: Seated bent-over rear delt raise with crossed cables; the closest match is an upright side lateral raise.

row.name_en: Cable Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
instructions_en: Sit on the end of a bench between two low pulleys and lean forward until your chest is near your thighs, back flat.
Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, cables crossed below your knees.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with soft elbows, then lower slowly.

decisions.name: Shoulder Shrugs: Smith Machine
decisions.reason: Smith machine (multipress) shrug; same as wger-575 Shrugs on Multipress.

decisions.name: Push Up: Bench (Feet Elevated)
decisions.reason: Feet-on-bench push-up; same as Push-Ups With Feet Elevated.

decisions.name: Push Up: Body Weight
decisions.reason: Standard push-up; same as Pushups.

decisions.name: Narrow Parallel Grip Chin-ups
decisions.reason: Close neutral-grip pull-up on parallel handles; same as V-Bar Pullup.

decisions.name: Wide Grip Chin Up
decisions.reason: Source pulls to alternate sides of a wide bar; same as Side To Side Chins.

decisions.name: Dead Lifts: Smith Machine
decisions.reason: Conventional pull from low in the Smith machine with knee bend, not the hip-hinge Romanian or stiff-legged version.

instructions_en: Set the safety stops so the bar rests at mid-shin, stand with feet hip-width under it and grip just outside your knees.
Brace with a flat back, unhook the bar and stand tall by pushing the floor away, hips and knees extending together.
Lower by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until the bar nearly reaches the stops.

decisions.name: Good Mornings: Smith Machine
decisions.reason: Smith machine version of the good morning; no straight-knee Smith version in the library.

instructions_en: Set the bar at upper-chest height, step under it so it rests across your upper back, feet hip-width apart.
Unhook the bar, soften your knees and push your hips back, lowering your torso toward parallel with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then rehook the bar at the end of the set.

decisions.name: Supermans
decisions.reason: Same as Superman.

decisions.name: Dead Lifts: Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Conventional deadlift from the floor with bent knees; the closest is the Romanian (hinge-only) version.

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor beside each foot.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the dumbbells, brace with a flat back, then stand up tall.
Lower the dumbbells back to the floor along your legs, keeping your spine neutral.

decisions.name: Bridging
decisions.reason: Bodyweight glute bridge; same as Butt Lift (Bridge).

decisions.name: Lunges: Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Stationary forward dumbbell lunge; same as wger-205 Dumbbell Lunges Standing.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Hack Squat
decisions.reason: Bar held behind the legs in a Smith machine; differs from the Hack Squat sled machine and the free-barbell version.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar just above ankle height and stand facing away from it, heels just in front of the bar.
Squat down to grip the bar behind your legs with an overhand grip, unhook it and stand up tall.
Squat until your thighs reach parallel, keeping your chest up and knees over your toes, then drive back up.

decisions.name: Lunges: Barbell (Rear)
decisions.reason: Barbell reverse (step-back) lunge; same as wger-1830 Barbell Step Back Lunge.

decisions.name: Side Squats: Barbell
decisions.reason: Wide-stance barbell side squat onto one leg; same as Barbell Side Split Squat.

decisions.name: One Arm Snatch with Barbell
decisions.reason: Single-arm barbell snatch is a circus-style, unsafe lift nobody programs; use the dumbbell snatch or barbell snatch instead.

decisions.name: Pile Squat with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Plie (sumo) dumbbell squat; same as Plie Dumbbell Squat.

decisions.name: Weighted Sissy Squat with Weight Plate
decisions.reason: Plate-loaded sissy squat; same as Weighted Sissy Squat.

decisions.name: Zecher Squats
decisions.reason: Typo of Zercher squat; same as Zercher Squats.

decisions.name: Triceps Dips: Machine
decisions.reason: Seated dip machine; same as Dip Machine.

decisions.name: Triceps Dips: Body Weight
decisions.reason: Upright parallel-bar dip with elbows tucked; same as Dips - Triceps Version.

decisions.name: Kneeling Triceps Concentration Extension with Cable
decisions.reason: Single-arm high-pulley extension with the upper arm braced on the thigh; the closest is a two-hand overhead rope extension.

instructions_en: Kneel on one knee beside a high pulley, other foot forward, and grab a single handle with the arm on the forward-leg side.
Rest the back of that upper arm against the inner thigh of your forward leg, elbow bent and pointing down.
Extend the elbow to push the handle toward the floor, then return slowly; finish the set and switch arms.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Lying)
decisions.reason: Lying dumbbell triceps extension (one dumbbell held in both hands); no material difference.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm extended straight above your shoulder.
Keeping the upper arm still, bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell across your face toward the opposite shoulder.
Extend the elbow to press the dumbbell back up; finish the set, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Lying Two Arm)
decisions.reason: Two-dumbbell lying extension; same as Lying Dumbbell Tricep Extension.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell or EZ-bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, arms extended over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms still and angled slightly back, bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back up, keeping your wrists firm.

decisions.name: Close Triceps Pushup
decisions.reason: Same as Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Seated, One Arm)
decisions.reason: Source describes a seated one-arm kickback; same as Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Seated, Two Arm)
decisions.reason: Source describes a seated two-arm kickback; same as Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Barbell (Seated, Overhead)
decisions.reason: Seated, back-supported version; the library has only the standing barbell overhead extension, and wger-1519 is a generic sit-or-stand entry.

instructions_en: Sit upright on a bench with back support, holding a barbell or EZ-bar overhead with a narrow overhand grip.
Keeping your elbows pointing up and close to your head, bend them to lower the bar behind your head.
Extend your elbows to return the bar overhead without arching your lower back.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Bent-Over, One Arm)
decisions.reason: Same exercise (standing bent-over one-arm kickback).

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Bent-Over, Two Arm)
decisions.reason: Source is standing, not seated; same as Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Cable (One Arm, Low-Pulley)
decisions.reason: Same as Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Triceps Kickback with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Bench-supported dumbbell kickback; same as Tricep Dumbbell Kickback.

decisions.name: Triceps Pushdown: Cable (V-Bar)
decisions.reason: Same as Triceps Pushdown - V-Bar Attachment.

decisions.name: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Incline)
decisions.reason: Lying back on an incline bench with two dumbbells; the closest is a generic seated/standing overhead extension.

instructions_en: Lie back on an incline bench holding two dumbbells above your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
Extend your elbows to bring the dumbbells back above your shoulders.

decisions.name: Lying Incline Curl with Barbell
decisions.reason: Prone incline barbell curl; same as Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline.

decisions.name: Hammer Curls with Rope and Cable
decisions.reason: Same as Cable Hammer Curls - Rope Attachment.

decisions.reason: Same as Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl.

decisions.reason: Same as Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl.

decisions.name: Biceps Curl: Dumbbell (Hammer)
decisions.reason: Standing dumbbell hammer curl; same as Hammer Curls.

decisions.name: Incline Biceps Curl with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Seated incline dumbbell curl; same as Incline Dumbbell Curl.

decisions.name: Lying Bicep Cable Curl
decisions.reason: Low-pulley curl lying on the floor; same as Lying Cable Curl.

decisions.name: Lying Close Grip Biceps Curls with Cable
decisions.reason: Lying under a high pulley, close-grip bar curl; same exercise.

decisions.name: Lying High Bench Biceps Curl with Barbell
decisions.reason: Same as Lying High Bench Barbell Curl.

decisions.reason: Same as Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl.

decisions.name: One Arm Bicep Curl with Olympic Bar or Barbell
decisions.reason: Single-arm curl balancing a full barbell by its middle is a gimmicky balance stunt, not a programmable curl.

decisions.name: Biceps Curl: Squat with Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Squat combined with a curl; not a plain dumbbell curl.

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Squat until your thighs reach about parallel, keeping your chest up and the dumbbells hanging.
Drive back up to standing, then curl the dumbbells to your shoulders and lower them before the next rep.

decisions.name: Biceps Curl: Dumbbell (Reverse)
decisions.reason: Overhand-grip dumbbell curl; same as Standing Dumbbell Reverse Curl.

decisions.name: Dead Lift: Barbell (Biceps Curl)
decisions.reason: Gimmicky deadlift-plus-curl combo; the curl caps the load so the hinge is pointless, and it is rarely programmed.

decisions.name: Lateral Lunge with Bicep Curl with Dumbbell

row.name_en: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge with Biceps Curl
instructions_en: Stand with feet together, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing forward.
Step wide to one side and sit your hips back into that leg, other leg straight, while curling the dumbbells up.
Lower the dumbbells as you push back to the start; alternate sides.

decisions.name: Forward Lunge with Bicep Curl using Dumbbell

row.name_en: Dumbbell Forward Lunge with Biceps Curl
instructions_en: Stand tall with feet together, holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor while curling the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells as you push back to the start; alternate legs.

decisions.name: Step Up: Dumbbell (Bicep Curl, Single Leg Balance)
decisions.reason: Gimmicky triple combo (step-up, curl and single-leg balance); the component exercises cover it.

decisions.name: Stork Stance Bicep Curl with Dumbbells
decisions.reason: Gimmicky balance variant of the dumbbell curl (curling on one leg); adds nothing a gym would program.

decisions.name: Donkey Calf Raises
decisions.reason: Donkey calf raise (partner on the hips instead of the machine pad); same movement and name.

decisions.name: Seated Ab Crunch with Cable
decisions.reason: Seated crunch with a high-pulley rope; same as Cable Seated Crunch.
